name: Exit level (no event)
description: Leaves the level at once, back to the overworld, without triggering any overworld event: it clears how the level was exited ($0DD5), which decides the events, clears the overworld override ($0109), enables the side exit flag ($1B96), sets the overworld process ($13D9) and the game mode ($0100 = $0B). Adapted from the Exit Block (no OW events) of SMWC 19071; not tried in an emulator by us.
